title: A passing make ci leaves no build a sibling can pin
foundBy: user report (host): "it doesn't seem possible anymore to have make repin do pin on local builds, which haven't been published to ghcr.io or npmjs.com or built in the Github CI builds"
details: `make ci` runs every gate CI runs, on this machine, and leaves nothing another project can pin. Pins move only to commits GitHub CI lists as built. So a change across several projects has to be pushed and built one project at a time before the next can pin it. A clean passing run could record its commit as a local build instead: the module zip Go resolves it from, and an entry naming its versions. They would go in a store the sibling projects read. Go and npm builds of a clean commit are byte-identical to CI's. A pin on such a build is therefore the pin CI writes once that commit is pushed.
